title: Orchard and Regiment
author: Oscar Delacroix
blurb: Kestrel Okafor, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
